imap_host.description: IMAP server host name or IP address, as entered in a mail client.

imap_port.description: IMAP TCP port. Accepted before storage: 143 or 993.

imap_security.description: IMAP transport security: tls (implicit TLS), starttls, or none.

smtp_host.description: SMTP submission server host name or IP address, as entered in a mail client.

smtp_port.description: SMTP TCP port. Accepted before storage: 25, 465, or 587.

smtp_security.description: SMTP transport security: tls (implicit TLS), starttls, or none.

username.description: Account username used for IMAP and, unless smtp_username is set, SMTP authentication.

password.description: Account password or provider-issued app password. Stored as a secret and never printed.

smtp_username.description: Optional SMTP username when it differs from username.

from_address.description: Optional RFC 5322 From address. Defaults to username when username is an address.

mailbox.description: Mailbox used by the messages stream. Set a separate credential or reset its state before changing this value.
